AccessRules.description_en: The collection of permission group rules

items.description_en: The collection of permission group rules

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the permission group rule
CreateTime.description_zh: 权限组规则的创建时间

Description.description_en: The description of the permission group rule
Description.description_zh: 权限组规则的描述信息

NetworkSegment.description_en: The IP address or network segment of the authorization object
NetworkSegment.description_zh: 授权对象的IP地址或网段

Priority.description_en:
The priority of the permission group rule.

When the same authorization object matches multiple rules, the rule with the higher priority takes effect.

Valid values: 1 to 100. A value of 1 represents the highest priority
Priority.description_zh:
权限组规则优先级。

当同一个授权对象匹配到多条规则时，高优先级规则生效。

取值范围：1~100，1为最高优先级

RWAccessType.description_en:
The access control list of the authorization object on the file system.

Valid values:

RDWR: read and write
RDONLY: read-only
RWAccessType.description_zh:
授权对象对文件系统的读写权限。

包括：

RDWR：可读可写
RDONLY：只读

NextToken.description_en:
The next page identity.

If a query result does not fully return all folders, NextToken is not empty. You can upload the correct NextToken in your query to continue retrieving results
NextToken.description_zh:
下一页标识。
